cases.question: What did he do at Miele?
cases.answer: Blessing worked as a Data Engineer at Miele from 08/2024 to 03/2026. He built batch ETL pipelines on Databricks with PySpark, automated testing and deployment with CI/CD and Terraform, and delivered Power BI semantic models and dashboards. He also extracted SAP FI/CO data via OData services and BAPIs with Azure Data Factory, and developed the gold layer as dbt models with dimensional modeling. [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7]

cases.question: Tell me about ShopFlow
cases.answer: ShopFlow is a personal learning project that builds a complete analytics platform on the public Olist dataset [1]. It uses various tools such as Python, SQL, dbt, Airflow, and PostgreSQL to load and analyze data [2]. The platform includes features such as data modeling, data visualization, and a question-answering agent [3, 4, 5]. It also has a simple web interface [6].
